## Research

::: {.cv-entry}
**The Sprawl Paradox: Redefining American Urbanity Through Density**
::: {.year}
2025
:::
Introduces the True Urban Core (TUC) metric for density-based city ranking. [→](https://bleonardi.github.io/True_Urban_Ranking_Project/)
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
**Transit Fragmentation Research: Quantifying Governance Friction**
::: {.year}
2025
:::
Develops the Transit Fragmentation Index (TFI) using NTD data across 480+ urbanized areas. [→](https://bleonardi.github.io/Transit_Fragmentation_Research/)
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
**Transportation ROI Analysis: OKI Region**
::: {.year}
2025
:::
Fiscal productivity analysis of federal transportation investment vs. property tax yield across 8 counties. [→](https://bleonardi.github.io/Transportation_ROI_Analysis/)
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
**Brent Spence Bridge: Home Price Event Study**
::: {.year}
2025
:::
Event study of infrastructure milestone effects on residential prices in Cincinnati/NKY. [→](https://bleonardi.github.io/BSB_Impact_Analysis/)
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
**Canonical Rigidity & Sacred Space: US Catholic Parishes**
::: {.year}
2025
:::
Spatial econometric analysis of parish boundary rigidity and urban land use inefficiency. [→](https://bleonardi.github.io/US_Catholic_Churches/)
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
**Do Federal Reserve Banks Research What Their Districts Produce?**
::: {.year}
2025
:::
Topic modeling of ~18,300 Fed working papers against district industry composition. [→](https://bleonardi.github.io/Fed_Research_Districts/)
:::
